description: "The Deformities of the Fingers and Toes" by William Anderson is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The work focuses on various pathological conditions that affect the fingers and toes, particularly detailing surgical diseases and deformities, while offering insights into their causes, symptoms, and treatment options.
